review.rationale: Option A provides a robust, bounded, and safe deployment execution model. It correctly identifies and mitigates the ownership risk (501:staff) by enforcing a strict extraction policy that normalizes ownership to root:root. The use of artifact-addressed paths prevents identity collisions. The compare-and-swap (CAS) guard ensures that the deployment target has not drifted since the preflight check. The atomic symlink switch with an in-session rollback mechanism minimizes the window of vulnerability and ensures recoverability. The strict caps and stop conditions prevent scope creep and unauthorized changes. The recommendation clearly separates the deployment execution from any new product release or production readiness authorization, preserving authority boundaries.
